summary: ExpressionRulesEngine: vectorized, single-pass rule evaluation against a context, producing ranked RuleResult output.

key_classes.name: ExpressionRulesEngine
key_classes.summary: Compiles DimensionsMetadata at construction; evaluates contexts in a single vectorized pass via mountainash.relations.Relation. Two construction paths: dimension_metadata (auto-compiled) or dimension_expressions (advanced, pre-compiled).

extension_points: dimension_expressions constructor argument allows injecting pre-compiled expressions for advanced use cases.
lifecycle_notes: Evaluation pipeline: bind ctx literals → compute ternary columns → survived/specificity → sort → rank → filter.
Backend is determined by the type of `rules` passed at construction; result returns the same backend.
documentation_hooks: The evaluate() method signature (context, dimensions, top_n, min_specificity, include_observability) is the primary user API.
include_observability=True keeps __t_<dim> columns in output for explainability — document this default.

evidence.detail: ExpressionRulesEngine.evaluate() is the public entry point
integration tests cover full evaluate flow
